answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The fable lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the basalt is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
